title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Avalanche vs. Snowball: Choosing Your Payoff Plan

questions.text: According to the narration, which debt repayment method prioritizes paying off the debt with the highest interest rate first?
questions.explanation: The narration states that the avalanche method focuses on paying the debt with the highest interest rate first to save money on interest over time.

questions.text: True or false: Both the avalanche and snowball methods require you to make the minimum payment on every debt before applying any extra cash to the chosen target debt.
questions.explanation: The narration explicitly says: 'Both methods require you to make the minimum payment on every debt, then put any extra cash toward the chosen target debt.'
